mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rates compress equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positively correlated with FEDFUNDS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or the negative direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, increasing equity market drawdown risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in the last month, or the negative direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% and housing starts exceed 1300 thousand units, it signals an overheating economy triggering aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1300, or the negative direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and rising over the last 3 months), increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS rising > 0.1% in last 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when the monetary tightening cycle condition is met, or the negative direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negatively correlated with HOUST (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or the positive direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 in the last month signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the negative direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100.0 and residential sales (RSAFS) are below 700,000 million dollars, it signals a deepening recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0 and RSAFS < 700000.0, or the negative direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Higher residential sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negatively correlated with RSAFS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window, or the positive direction is not statistically significant (t-test p>0.05) in the most recent 3 years.
